nodes.display_name: A frog that swallowed a ring
nodes.long_description:
1.Throw a dart at the frog to anesthetize it
2.Put on gloves and use a scalpel to cut open the frog's abdomen
3.Use tweezers to open the cut abdomen
4.Take out the organs with tweezers
5.Cut open the stomach to retrieve the missing ring
6.Suture the stomach with medical thread and a needle
7.Put the organs back in
8.Suture the stomach back together with medical thread and stitches
nodes.short_description:
Cut open a frog's stomach in virtual reality to learn the names and descriptions of all of its organs 
and descriptions of all the frog's organs and learn about their structure and roles.
